description: This file declares the class LocalInstanceGroup, which manages groups of local instances in the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes declarations for creating, deserializing, and managing instance group data, as well as methods for querying and modifying its state.

classes.name: LocalInstanceGroup
classes.description: A class representing a group of local Android virtual device instances, providing methods for creation, configuration, querying, and state management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new LocalInstanceGroup from a given instance group protocol buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON value into a LocalInstanceGroup object.

methods.name: const std::string & GroupName() const
methods.description: Returns the name of the instance group.

methods.name: const std::string & HomeDir() const
methods.description: Returns the home directory path of the group.

methods.name: SetHomeDir
methods.description: Sets the home directory path for the group.

methods.name: const std::string & HostArtifactsPath() const
methods.description: Returns the host artifacts path.

methods.name: SetHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Sets the host artifacts path.

methods.name: const std::string & ProductOutPath() const
methods.description: Returns the product output path.

methods.name: SetProductOutPath
methods.description: Sets the product output path.

methods.name: StartTime
methods.description: Retrieves the start time of the instance group.

methods.name: SetStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the group.

methods.name: const std::vector<LocalInstance> & Instances() const
methods.description: Returns the list of LocalInstance objects belonging to this group.

methods.name: HasActiveInstances
methods.description: Checks if there are active instances within the group.

methods.name: const cvd::InstanceGroup & Proto() const
methods.description: Returns a reference to the underlying protocol buffer representing the group.

methods.name: SetAllStates
methods.description: Sets the state for all instances in the group.

methods.name: AssemblyDir
methods.description: Returns the directory assembly path for the group.

methods.name: FindInstanceById
methods.description: Finds an instance in the group by its unique ID.

methods.name: FindByInstanceName
methods.description: Finds instances by their per-instance name.

methods.name: FetchStatus
methods.description: Fetches the status of all instances, waiting up to a specified timeout.

methods.name: std::vector<LocalInstance> & Instances()
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: GroupName
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::string& GroupName() const { return group_proto_->name(); }$/

ctags.name: HomeDir
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::string& HomeDir() const { return group_proto_->home_directory(); }$/

ctags.name: Instances
ctags.pattern: /^  const std::vector<LocalInstance>& Instances() const { return instances_; }$/
